parsed.summary: A systematic review of the netlist against the specification found the build functionally faithful: the power paths (SS54 series diode on the external 5V input J9, PMEG3030EP diode D3 feeding the 4x100uF servo rail, P-FET Q3 gating the battery to bus pin 29, and the 0.1uF C1 on +3V3), the servo interface jumpers (1k series R21/R22, four 0-ohm select jumpers R7/R16/R3/R13, two 0-ohm bridge jumpers R5/R9), and the MAX3485 U2 with its PNP auto-direction stage (Q1 with 10k/5.1k drive and 20k DE/RE pulldown) and fail-safe/bias network (2k on A, 2.2k/2.2k mid-rail on B) are all present and connected as described. All component values match the spec's set exactly, no nets are shorted or merged, and every pin is accounted for, so no defensible anomaly could be identified.
